description: This Java class provides a pretty printer for temporal expressions, implementing the TemporalExpressionVisitor interface to traverse and format various temporal expression objects into a human-readable string format.

classes.name: TemporalExpressionPrinter
classes.description: A class that pretty-prints temporal expressions by traversing their structure and formatting them into a readable string representation.

methods.name: TemporalExpressionPrinter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the printer with a temporal expression and optional indentation size.

methods.name: appendExpression
methods.description: Appends a textual representation of the expression with proper indentation.

methods.name: appendIndent
methods.description: Appends spaces according to the current indentation level.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Traverses the expression and returns its pretty-printed string.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Methods implementing the Visitor pattern for different temporal expression types, formatting each accordingly.
